commission_kiln_entry.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_entry.text: A shallow courtyard had opened behind the kiln since Yue's first apprenticeship. Its benches stood beneath reed awnings, with a drain down the middle and a gate wide enough for an ordinary handcart. The workers called it the assay courtyard because comparisons happened there. The name did not make every comparison a chemical assay. Yue arrived carrying her permitted career record, prepared to ask what the new commission actually required before admiring the clean space.

commission_kiln_entry_02.speaker: peng_ai
commission_kiln_entry_02.text: Peng had put the offer on the lowest bench, beside a stone that stopped the pages escaping. 'Six completed shifts,' she said. 'Seven copper each, paid at the end of each day. The work is household-vessel receiving, cold-use comparison and a supervised report. The job may use the specialty you actually earned. It cannot give you authority over firing programs or somebody else's structure merely by placing your name on the report.'

commission_kiln_entry_03.speaker: lin_yue
commission_kiln_entry_03.text: Yue read the scope aloud. Eight serving bowls would go to a shared towpath kitchen, where several households took turns making the meal. The purchasers wanted stable cold placement and a rim that would let wet cloth pass without catching. Actual hot use remained under the maker's established specification, outside Yue's new comparison. She could report ordinary observations and their limits. She could not invent a hot test because a hungry household wanted certainty faster.

commission_kiln_entry_04.speaker: tan_ning
commission_kiln_entry_04.text: Tan brought the purchaser's offer instead of paraphrasing it. The households had deposited one hundred twenty copper: eighty for eight bowls, twenty for ordinary packing and delivery, and twenty for one further service they would choose after review. The service reserve could not buy three improvements. A delayed decision would keep that twenty in escrow. Tan had a reason to want the order finished, and he entered that interest beside his commercial role.

commission_kiln_entry_05.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_entry_05.text: The hall funded the commission separately. Ninety copper covered forty-two in Yue's six wages, eighteen in permitted comparison consumables, twelve in independent review time and eighteen reserved for actual replacement losses. A separate eighteen-copper provision allocation supplied meals and her bed for the six accepted days. No household service money would pay her trial wages. No apprentice's withheld pay would absorb a broken comparison piece. Peng named the receiving book for each account before asking for a signature.

commission_kiln_entry_06.speaker: peng_ai
commission_kiln_entry_06.text: Any documented earlier four-week offer retained its actual status. An accepted first booking supplied no wage for an unworked day; a missing record supplied no invented appointment. Peng proposed this six-shift commission, exchanging any existing unworked first booking and cancelling conflicting unworked dates by mutual agreement. Completed money would stay earned. Without an older booking to amend, only the new term required acceptance. Renewal afterward would need another actual offer.

commission_kiln_entry_07.speaker: lin_yue
commission_kiln_entry_07.text: 'I accept the six-shift term and the agreed amendment of any documented unworked booking,' Yue said, then signed the dated scope. Peng signed for the hall. The first seven copper would follow the first completed day. Any retained trainee receipt stayed separate; an absent receipt supplied no advance. Yue wanted the job enough to ask the inconvenient question about stopping. Completed hours would still be paid if a task stopped before the booked day ended.

commission_kiln_entry_08.speaker: luo_sheng
commission_kiln_entry_08.text: Luo walked her through the courtyard without asking her to demonstrate a grander reach. Her present clearance allowed ordinary waist work, not a sudden overhead catch. The bowls would come down by the rack handler before she received them. A fifth-stage practitioner still had four brief assessed pairs, no endless personal source and no untested circuit method. The indicator, when needed, would use its isolated source under its responsible operator. Yue's task was to observe and report within scope.

commission_kiln_entry_09.speaker: zhu_yan
commission_kiln_entry_09.text: Zhu held up a sample with a broad unpainted foot. 'The households want this to stand on their counter,' she said. 'I want the rim to look like the cloud before rain. Those wishes can disagree.' She would make the pieces and answer for their established specification. Yue would compare the stated cold-use questions. Zhu's authorship and friendship would appear in the review record. She could contribute a result without claiming to be free of preference.

commission_kiln_entry_10.speaker: jian_rong
commission_kiln_entry_10.text: Jian was assigned covered trays and permitted cold handling under his own supervisor. The commission did not complete his unfinished qualification or replace his next assessment date. He asked whether he might watch Yue's report review. Peng offered a place during its public cold-method portion, leaving the purchasers' private household notes outside his access. He accepted that smaller invitation and fetched the proper covers. Yue noticed how carefully he avoided turning the permission into a wider one.

commission_kiln_entry_11.speaker: tian_min
commission_kiln_entry_11.text: Tian Min arrived with the towpath households' offered use note and a bundle of ordinary cleaning cloth. Her authority covered this purchase and the permitted comparison, not every family's private disagreements. 'They share a counter but not a single pair of hands,' she said. 'Please do not tell them a bowl is good because our strongest cook managed it.' She had one scheduled visit today and another at final receiving. Yue wrote those limits beside the offered cloth.

commission_kiln_entry_12.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_entry_12.text: Before work began, Peng checked the career record for the specialty actually demonstrated in the earlier term. A requested specialty and a completed practical result were different entries. An available earlier decision could direct her to the corresponding record; a missing record would leave the specialty blank and keep Yue under ordinary candidate supervision. The new work remained available at that level. A label could guide today's appointment. It could not silently supply yesterday's examination.

commission_kiln_scope_reader.speaker: peng_ai
commission_kiln_scope_reader.text: Peng opened the retained specialty record before assigning today's responsibility. The three earlier choices pointed to different bounded practical results. She would use the witnessed result where it was present, with its old failure and retest intact. An unavailable earlier record left Yue a supervised candidate on this commission, with no specialist title inferred. The work's budget and stop remained the same. Yue waited for the actual assignment rather than choosing a new past.

commission_kiln_scope_indicator.speaker: luo_sheng
commission_kiln_scope_indicator.text: The retained observation specialty named the isolated stand model Yue had demonstrated. Its witnessed practical entry still included a failed first placement and the successful corrective retest. Luo assigned her ordinary setup observation and sample correspondence, keeping source operation with himself. The courtyard's new awning did not expand that scope. Yue could stop an observation whose setup no longer matched the declared method. She could not repair a source circuit from familiarity with its dial.

commission_kiln_scope_indicator_02.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_scope_indicator_02.text: The stand had acquired a transport brace since the earlier term. Yue inspected it unpowered, following the responsible operator's current procedure. Its pin was seated, but its painted mark had worn away where thumbs rested. She copied the actual pin position and asked Luo to renew the mark before anybody relied on a convenient glance. The small maintenance task belonged to him. Reporting it clearly belonged to the observation work she had earned.

commission_kiln_scope_indicator_03.speaker: lin_yue
commission_kiln_scope_indicator_03.text: She wanted the title to make the first morning less tentative. Instead it gave her a more exact question to ask. The shared kitchen's bowls would not be good or bad because an indicator looked respectable. Its result would remain one measured comparison under specified conditions. Yue would also carry the ordinary receiving sheet and cold-use note. Her specialty could sharpen one part of the report without swallowing the rest of it.

commission_kiln_scope_indicator_04.speaker: zhu_yan
commission_kiln_scope_indicator_04.text: Zhu laid out the numbered cold specimens while Luo renewed the transport mark. She would independently check their identities and the dry physical closure. She did not claim authority over Yue's internal routes or the stand's live source. The review would preserve those limits. 'I can be useful without becoming your entire examination board,' she said. Yue answered that an entire board with Zhu's eyebrows would make beginning any test much harder.

commission_kiln_scope_indicator_05.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_scope_indicator_05.text: The two laughed, then returned to the current sheet. One old comparison vessel had been moved to another shelf after the trainee term. Yue initially pointed to its former position. Zhu corrected her and made her locate the actual number. The qualification had survived the move; the contents of the room had not promised to stand still around it. The correction stayed in today's preparation notes, ordinary enough to be both irritating and useful.

commission_kiln_scope_indicator_06.speaker: peng_ai
commission_kiln_scope_indicator_06.text: Peng recorded the observation assignment within Yue's retained demonstrated scope. Cold-use and source conclusions would carry their own named checks. The first review would ask whether she had kept the parts separate, not whether she had made every worker sound like a specialist. A wider future role could be proposed after actual work. It was not tucked into this six-day signature. Yue took the current stand sheet and left the circuit key with Luo.

commission_kiln_scope_vessel.speaker: zhu_yan
commission_kiln_scope_vessel.text: The retained vessel specialty covered cold stability, rim-use comparison and traceable handling under the hall's household method. Its witnessed practical entry preserved the first failed attempt and later retest. Zhu assigned Yue the purchasers' cold comparison, with no new hot-performance conclusion. She herself would answer for the firing specification as maker. Yue could reject a cold-use claim the observation did not support without pretending the rejection diagnosed every cause inside the ceramic.

commission_kiln_scope_vessel_02.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_scope_vessel_02.text: The first sample's rim looked almost exactly like the one Yue had examined in the trainee term. Its underside carried a current batch number. She checked that number before borrowing the earlier result. The old comparison had taught a method, not tested this piece in advance. Zhu waited while Yue prepared a clean board and noted its supports. Remembering the failed first examination made the ordinary setup check slower in a useful way.

commission_kiln_scope_vessel_03.speaker: lin_yue
commission_kiln_scope_vessel_03.text: She read Tian's offered use note and found the counter height omitted. A bowl could be easy to move on the hall's bench and awkward at the purchasers' actual place. She asked for a measured height at final receiving, keeping today's result limited to the comparison bench. The question did not authorize her to redesign the household counter. It told the report where its evidence ended. Tian promised the measurement during her scheduled visit, not an unscheduled household inspection.

commission_kiln_scope_vessel_04.speaker: tian_min
commission_kiln_scope_vessel_04.text: Tian demonstrated the cleaning motion with an empty cold sample. Her palm met the broad rim differently from Zhu's smaller hand. One cloth snag appeared only when Tian turned the bowl toward her body. Yue recorded the motion rather than naming an imaginary average household. Tian had offered this demonstration within this short permitted comparison visit. Her account would be useful as one user's observation, without requiring every cook to provide an equally personal story.

commission_kiln_scope_vessel_05.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_scope_vessel_05.text: Zhu changed the proposed finishing line after the witnessed snag, retaining the unchanged sample for comparison. Yue admired the alteration and nearly wrote improved on the report before the revised piece had been made. She left a blank instead. Wanting the modification to work did not give it an observed result. The blank made Zhu impatient because the curve existed so clearly in her head. It also gave the next trial something honest to answer.

commission_kiln_scope_vessel_06.speaker: peng_ai
commission_kiln_scope_vessel_06.text: Peng entered the cold-vessel assignment within Yue's demonstrated specialty. Instrument readings and original-source correspondence would still have their responsible checks. The report could place those observations beside hers without granting her their separate authority. A wider role might follow actual future practice, but this term asked for a bounded result. Yue took the current use sheet and kept the attractive unmade curve out of the completed-observation column.

commission_kiln_scope_source.speaker: peng_ai
commission_kiln_scope_source.text: The retained receiving-source specialty covered copying, bounded comparison and traceable specimen correspondence. Its practical entry retained the failed first attempt, coached or independent correction and actual later pass. Peng assigned Yue the permitted source packet for the shared kitchen order. The role did not authorize private-credit decisions or access to protected care folders. A neat copy could make a question usable. It could not decide the question's answer because its margins looked professionally kept.

commission_kiln_scope_source_02.speaker: tan_ning
commission_kiln_scope_source_02.text: Tan offered the current originals with the permitted copying scope. One supplier entry had a fold over its last digit. Yue marked the legible portion before comparing the whole line. The older unreadable digit from her trainee lesson remained unresolved in its own packet; today's clearer source did not cure it by resemblance. Tan signed the access note and kept custody of the originals. Yue could finish a working copy without collecting a new private archive.

commission_kiln_scope_source_03.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_scope_source_03.text: The order's batch number appeared on three pieces of paper. Yue traced each back to the record from which it had been copied. Two were copies of the same receiving entry. The third came from the maker's specimen list. She kept that dependency visible. Three agreeing sheets could carry only two offered sources. The distinction would matter if a later report mistook repeated handwriting for independent confirmation. She underlined it once rather than making the page dramatic.

commission_kiln_scope_source_04.speaker: zhu_yan
commission_kiln_scope_source_04.text: Zhu independently located the numbered cold sample against the maker's list. She found Yue's first copied number attached to the adjacent specimen and corrected it before the copy was issued. Yue retained the wrong draft with the comparison note. The specialty had not promised flawless digits. It had promised a method in which another person could inspect how a digit came to represent a particular object. That was inconvenient enough to deserve its own paid time.

commission_kiln_scope_source_05.speaker: lin_yue
commission_kiln_scope_source_05.text: Yue asked whether the purchasers would understand why their report contained crossed-out correspondence. Tian said they would understand a visible correction more easily than a beautiful page that led them to the wrong bowl. The households wanted a usable purchase, not an exhibition of Yue's handwriting. She copied the final permitted entries plainly and kept the correction available behind them. Her pride had become more patient than it had been on the first apprenticeship morning.

commission_kiln_scope_source_06.speaker: peng_ai
commission_kiln_scope_source_06.text: Peng recorded the source assignment within the retained witnessed specialty. Cold-use observations and isolated-stand checks would carry their own reviewers. The document would not gain firing authority through the source technician's signature. A future request for more responsibility could be discussed after this term's actual result. Yue carried the permitted copy to the courtyard and left Tan's originals where their receiving note said they belonged.

commission_kiln_scope_common.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_scope_common.text: The common task sheet covered work possible under ordinary supervision if a specialist record was unavailable. Any confirmed specialty sharpened its assigned part; an unverified one remained blank. Yue would prepare the courtyard, receive the samples and preserve the declared limits while the responsible people checked their portions. The signed six-shift term paid for that work at the stated rate. It did not demand she manufacture a qualification out of confidence to deserve her first meal.

commission_kiln_scope_common_02.speaker: luo_sheng
commission_kiln_scope_common_02.text: Luo drew the courtyard's work boundary in chalk. The drying rack and live source stayed outside Yue's independent movements. The waist-height cold bench, covered receiving trays and clean drain were inside the assigned task area. A worker could ask to stop without first proving an injury. The chalk would wash off after rain, so the written positions and actual fixtures mattered more than the line's impressive whiteness. Yue walked the route once before carrying even an empty bowl.

commission_kiln_scope_common_03.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_scope_common_03.text: The first morning's work began with sweeping grit away from the reference boards. Jian wanted to sweep faster and raised a small cloud over the uncovered cloth. They stopped, covered the cloth and cleaned the board again. No supervisor called the dust harmless because it had come from a broom rather than a kiln. The correction cost ten minutes. The yard looked less picturesque afterward, with covers wherever Yue's opening impression had preferred a tidy display.

commission_kiln_scope_common_04.speaker: tian_min
commission_kiln_scope_common_04.text: Tian asked which day the kitchen should plan to receive the bowls. Tan offered the third day's provisional dispatch, subject to that day's permitted batch checks, with a clear report if that time changed. She had already arranged ordinary borrowed serving ware for the present week. The commission would not decide whether anyone ate tonight. It would decide which purchased bowls and one later service reached them. Yue felt the order become easier to think about once hunger stopped being a rhetorical lever.

commission_kiln_scope_common_05.speaker: zhu_yan
commission_kiln_scope_common_05.text: Zhu brought the first numbered pieces down from the rack by the ordinary handler. She had reserved the comparison stock in advance, and its eighteen-copper allowance covered three six-copper blocks. A failed trial could use its assigned block without turning food into a debt. Further stock would require another decision. Yue checked the cold pieces against the offered list while Jian covered the remainder. The materials belonged to the hall until an actual sale transferred them.

commission_kiln_scope_common_06.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_scope_common_06.text: By the time the receiving board stood ready, the gate shadow had reached the drain. Yue could hear ordinary production in the hall beyond the wall. Her work was a small part of that larger day, with a finite price and a purpose somebody else had named. She opened her notebook at a fresh page. Under the accepted scope she wrote the first actual sample number, then checked it against the piece before moving to the next.

commission_kiln_day_one.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_day_one.text: The first paid day received eight current household samples and three retained comparison pieces. Each current piece had its own number, although the order sold them as one matched set. Yue placed the set's offer beside the individual list instead of letting the shared price imply identical observations. The kitchen would need enough sound pieces at receiving. A good result on the first sample would be useful evidence about that sample, not a completed inspection of the remaining seven.

commission_kiln_day_one_02.speaker: lin_yue
commission_kiln_day_one_02.text: She read the use questions to Tian: cold placement, cloth passage, ordinary empty handling and source correspondence. The maker's established hot specification stood on a separate sheet. Yue would not put her name under that conclusion. Tian asked whether the report would still be worth reading with so many boundaries. Yue answered that she hoped its yeses would become more useful because the paper also told her where they stopped.

commission_kiln_day_one_03.speaker: tian_min
commission_kiln_day_one_03.text: Tian unfolded the cloth bundle. One piece had a mended edge that caught more readily than the smooth pieces. She had offered it because the households actually repaired their cleaning cloth instead of buying a new square every time a seam grew awkward. Yue recorded the offered condition. A rim comparison using only the hall's immaculate cloth would answer a smaller question. The mended piece stayed Tian's property, with return expected at final receiving.

commission_kiln_day_one_04.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_day_one_04.text: Zhu watched the first cloth pass and stopped Yue before she called a snag. The thread had caught on a loose knot in the cloth itself, well away from the rim. They checked the contact point and repeated the motion with the same marked section. This time the knot cleared and another thread caught at a rough spot on the ceramic. Yue kept both observations. A familiar kind of flaw did not deserve every available explanation.

commission_kiln_day_one_05.speaker: zhu_yan
commission_kiln_day_one_05.text: Zhu marked the rough place for her own finishing decision. She would compare the unchanged sample with a revised piece later. The report could record today's snag; it could not record the unperformed revision as successful. She said she hated being the maker of a blank column. Yue reminded her that a blank could still lead to a beautiful rim. Zhu answered that beautiful rims should consider arriving sooner, especially when a buyer had a naming feast to attend.

commission_kiln_day_one_06.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_day_one_06.text: Luo moved the isolated stand under the awning for its operator's current check. Yue helped by reading the numbered cold list, keeping the stand's findings beside the separate use observations. The instrument did not inspect cloth friction. The cloth did not inspect the indicator's calibration. A combined report could show their relevance without merging their causes. Jian watched the columns fill and asked whether there was a reward for making a table with fewer lines.

commission_kiln_day_one_07.speaker: peng_ai
commission_kiln_day_one_07.text: Peng said fewer lines could be a reward if fewer things had actually happened. She would not pay a technician extra for hiding work inside one impressive sentence. Yue counted the retained samples against their covers before lunch. One cover had an old specimen number beneath its new removable tag. Peng had her put the stale number in the cover record and keep the current specimen correspondence visible. A reused cover was ordinary; an ambiguous cover was repairable.

commission_kiln_day_one_08.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_day_one_08.text: After lunch Tian had to leave for her scheduled towpath work. She offered one last empty-bowl handling observation at the counter. Yue noted its height and her motion, then stopped when Tian's agreed visit ended. Another cook's different grip would need another person's actual participation. She could not multiply the one offered hand into a household consensus. Tian took the train of questions with her only in the form of a short permitted request.

commission_kiln_day_one_09.speaker: tan_ning
commission_kiln_day_one_09.text: Tan wanted a provisional dispatch notice by evening. Yue could report the eight received numbers, one witnessed snag and an unfinished revision. She could not recommend the whole set on those facts alone. He asked whether unfinished would frighten the purchasers. She asked whether finished would tell them something false. Tan sighed, then wrote current comparison continuing. It was less dramatic than either word and more accurate about the actual day.

commission_kiln_day_one_10.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_day_one_10.text: Jian cleaned the reference boards after the samples returned to their numbered covers. He put the brush beside the offered cloth by mistake, then moved it when Yue pointed to the separate return place. Nobody turned the small correction into another verdict on his unfinished apprenticeship. He told Yue his teacher had moved the next practice hour because of a production booking. The reason irritated him, but it had not cancelled the actual assessment. He went to check the new time.

commission_kiln_day_one_11.speaker: peng_ai
commission_kiln_day_one_11.text: Peng checked the completed receiving and first comparison work against the actual hours. The day had used the first six-copper block of permitted consumables. No replacement reserve had been spent. She paid seven copper from the hall's wage account, leaving thirty-five allocated for the five unworked days. The household escrow remained intact. Yue counted the money after receiving it and entered a separate line for the new commission, keeping any documented earlier receipts out of its wage total.

commission_kiln_day_one_12.speaker: lin_yue
commission_kiln_day_one_12.text: In her room Yue reread the provisional dispatch note and imagined the purchasers seeing only its unfinished line. She wanted to write a persuasive promise underneath. Instead she wrote the next question the yard could actually test. The first day's pay lay beside the notebook, ordinary money for ordinary work. Her fifth-stage record stayed folded in the pack. Neither the new copper nor the unfinished column altered the earned pairs in her body.

commission_kiln_day_one_13.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_day_one_13.text: The second morning offered one larger use-comparison block before the remaining batch work. Its six-copper consumable limit and booked courtyard time could support one approach in depth. The other questions would retain their partial evidence. Yue could lead an ordinary partnered handling comparison with practiced physical judgment, examine cloth passage at the waist-height counter, or trace the use account through its current sources. The choice would change the later household explanation, not just the title on today's worksheet.

commission_kiln_method_choice.speaker: lin_yue
commission_kiln_method_choice.text: Yue had one booked comparison block and several useful questions. A partnered handling trial could examine the declared ordinary movement while retaining her shoulder limits. A counter cloth trial could compare the actual mended cloth against selected rims. A source-led account could make the offered household needs and their differences usable. None would settle the unperformed alternatives. She chose which evidence the households would later receive in detail.

choices.text: Lead the cleared partnered handling comparison.
Compare cloth passage at the waist-height counter.
Trace the households' offered use accounts.

commission_kiln_method_handling.speaker: luo_sheng
commission_kiln_method_handling.text: Luo checked the permitted movement before the handling block. The trial used cold vessels at waist height, an ordinary short route and a partner assigned to the other side. No overhead catch, sudden suspended load or qi reinforcement belonged to it. Yue could lead the route check because practiced physical judgment made the plan legible to her. It did not make the bowl light enough to ignore its actual weight. They weighed the empty piece first.

commission_kiln_method_handling_02.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_method_handling_02.text: The route turned beside the drain, where one footboard flexed under ordinary pressure. Yue called a pause before any vessel crossed it. The hall's responsible worker replaced the board and checked the support. Her observation had identified a condition, not qualified her to calculate the repair. Luo moved the handling start later by the actual maintenance time. The time would come out of this booked block, leaving fewer repetitions instead of borrowing a future worker's hour.

commission_kiln_method_handling_03.speaker: lin_yue
commission_kiln_method_handling_03.text: She and the assigned partner began with an empty cold bowl, moved at the agreed pace and set it on the receiving bench together. Yue announced the turn too late on the first attempt. The partner stopped before turning, and they reset without shifting the load into a sudden catch. The safe stop belonged to the method, but the late instruction still belonged in her result. Leading a movement was more than surviving it.

commission_kiln_method_handling_04.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_method_handling_04.text: They repeated the empty movement with the turn announced before the narrow point. The placement was coordinated this time. Only after that did Luo authorize the declared room-temperature water load, measured within the ordinary trial limit. Yue kept the weight and route beside the observation. The result could inform this route at this load. It would not qualify the same vessels for an unseen stair, a crowded feast or hot liquid carried in somebody else's hands.

commission_kiln_method_handling_05.speaker: jian_rong
commission_kiln_method_handling_05.text: Jian read the receiving count and asked to act as the next partner. Luo declined because his current assigned role and clearance covered the covered tray, not the loaded trial. Jian returned to that task without making the refusal a story about Yue distrusting him forever. He could watch the instruction timing from outside the movement. He noticed that Yue spoke earlier on the second loaded pass and told her afterward, when the bowl was resting.

commission_kiln_method_handling_06.speaker: lin_yue
commission_kiln_method_handling_06.text: The partner reported that the earlier turn call made the motion easier to coordinate. Yue recorded that offered account separately from her own observation. The partner did not agree that the bowl felt comfortable in every possible grip, and she did not ask for that agreement. They had completed the declared route within its limit. The household explanation could now show an actual coordinated handoff, with the delay and late first instruction retained as part of how it was learned.

commission_kiln_method_handling_07.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_method_handling_07.text: At the end of the block the water returned to the yard's ordinary drain under the stated use permission. The vessels were dried and their current numbers checked before covering. The repair had reduced the number of completed repetitions; no additional trip appeared in the report. Cloth-passage questions and the full household source map remained only partially examined. Yue had chosen a handling answer with actual limits, leaving other questions alive enough to require their own later work.

commission_kiln_method_handling_08.speaker: peng_ai
commission_kiln_method_handling_08.text: Peng accepted the completed handling block as evidence for a coordinated household explanation within the observed ordinary route and load. Its six-copper consumable block was spent, leaving one six-copper block for later corrective work. A future handoff rehearsal could use the demonstrated sequence, but would still need its own paid time and participants. Yue stored the current record where Tian could inspect it on returning. The choice had finally become work somebody else could use.

commission_kiln_method_cloth.speaker: zhu_yan
commission_kiln_method_cloth.text: Zhu arranged the selected rims on the waist-height counter with Tian's offered mended cloth and the hall's smooth reference square. The permission covered cold cloth passage and ordinary empty handling. It did not authorize abrasion of retained pieces or a hot-liquid comparison. Yue checked the supports, marked the contact sections and asked Zhu to repeat the same movement independently. The six-copper block would buy one detailed comparison, not a claim that every textile in the households behaved alike.

commission_kiln_method_cloth_02.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_method_cloth_02.text: The mended edge caught on the first rim when Yue drew it toward the inner curve. The smooth square cleared the same place. Zhu repeated the marked motion and found the same difference. Then she turned the bowl and found another snag that Yue had missed. The maker's smaller hand changed the angle. They recorded both angles and the contact points, preserving the fact that one user and one cloth had supplied only part of the question.

commission_kiln_method_cloth_03.speaker: lin_yue
commission_kiln_method_cloth_03.text: Yue wanted the broad smooth rim to win because it made the result easy to explain. Its inner join caught the repaired cloth during the next marked pass. She held the thread still while Zhu observed where it met the ceramic, then eased it free by the permitted ordinary method. The comparison sample acquired a small surface scratch. It stayed as an altered retained sample with its event recorded, not a pristine object whose earlier condition silently continued.

commission_kiln_method_cloth_04.speaker: zhu_yan
commission_kiln_method_cloth_04.text: Zhu signed the alteration note and kept the scratch visible beneath a removable marker. The comparison permission had allowed ordinary cloth contact, and this loss belonged to that authorized use. The sample could remain useful for the snag question, but not for every untouched-surface claim. Yue asked whether the block should stop. Zhu checked the remaining permitted stock and time, then narrowed the next trial to the unaffected rim portion. Consent had become a current practical question.

commission_kiln_day_four_04.speaker: jian_rong
commission_kiln_day_four_04.text: Jian asked whether he could copy the public cold-method correction for his own notebook. commission_kiln_day_four_05.text: Tian sent the households' request for one final service within their twenty-copper reserve. commission_kiln_day_four_06.speaker: tan_ning
commission_kiln_day_four_06.text: Tan priced the options against actual current suppliers. Four washable counter mats would cost five copper each. Two staffed handoff sessions would cost ten each. commission_kiln_day_four_07.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_day_four_07.text: The mats could improve an ordinary cold counter condition but would need cleaning and would not certify hot handling. commission_kiln_day_four_08.speaker: peng_ai
commission_kiln_day_four_08.text: Peng accepted the completed fourth shift and paid seven copper, bringing Yue's received commission wages to twenty-eight. Fourteen remained for two unworked shifts. commission_kiln_day_four_09.speaker: lin_yue
commission_kiln_day_four_09.text: Yue wanted to keep the remaining service decision for tomorrow, as if another night might produce twenty more copper. It would produce no new reserve. commission_kiln_day_four_10.speaker: narrator

commission_kiln_service_choice.text: The service reserve held twenty copper. commission_kiln_service_mats_02.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_service_mats_02.text: The four mats arrived with different seams. Their maker had reused sound lengths of the declared cloth, keeping each finished dimension within the offered range. commission_kiln_service_mats_03.text: Yue wanted to trim the curled edge. The supplier's terms allowed inspection and an agreed return, not alteration by the receiving technician. commission_kiln_service_mats_04.text: Tan obtained the supplier's acceptance of the correction within the stated price. commission_kiln_service_mats_06.speaker: zhu_yan
commission_kiln_service_mats_06.text: Zhu independently repeated the declared placement and sideways movement. She saw the same lifted corner on the corrected mat. commission_kiln_service_mats_07.text: She prepared four numbered mats, the supplier's current washing note and the observed movement limit for delivery. commission_kiln_service_handoff_04.text: Tian obtained two pairs who agreed to the scheduled sessions at final receiving. commission_kiln_service_handoff_05.text: In the courtyard model, Luo demonstrated the dry turn and stopped when the receiving bench moved a finger-width under ordinary contact. commission_kiln_service_handoff_07.text: She prepared the two actual appointment sheets, movement limits and ordinary stop explanation for final receiving. commission_kiln_service_packet.text: Peng obtained the permitted copying scope for a current-use packet. commission_kiln_service_packet_02.text: The first proof put the failed dispatch summary above the corrected current result. commission_kiln_service_packet_03.speaker: tan_ning
commission_kiln_service_packet_03.text: Tan checked the purchase and dispatch lines against his current originals. commission_kiln_service_packet_04.text: Yue tested the wording by reading it to Jian without showing him the table. commission_kiln_service_packet_07.speaker: lin_yue
commission_kiln_service_packet_07.text: She prepared the current proof, source-permission note and scheduled explanation for delivery. commission_kiln_service_packet_08.text: The packet preparation finished with current proof approved for the stated copying work and final receiving still pending. commission_kiln_day_five.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_day_five.text: The fifth morning's shared check began with every proposed sale number visible on its own covered place. The reserve had no money for another actual loss. commission_kiln_day_five_02.speaker: zhu_yan
commission_kiln_day_five_02.text: Zhu selected the actual current pieces that met the declared purchase scope. commission_kiln_day_five_03.text: Peng compared the recommendation with the supporting events before Tan confirmed the sixth-day cart. commission_kiln_day_five_04.speaker: lin_yue
commission_kiln_day_five_04.text: She read the recommendation aloud to Tan and made him tell her what he believed it authorized. commission_kiln_day_five_05.speaker: tan_ning
commission_kiln_day_five_05.text: Tan confirmed the later ten-copper cart and six-copper packing. Together with the lost four-copper reservation, they would spend the full delivery twenty. commission_kiln_day_five_06.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_day_five_06.text: Jian performed the changed covered-tray movement under his actual supervisor. commission_kiln_day_five_07.text: Peng booked the final twelve-copper review allocation in three four-copper portions: current original correspondence, independently repeated cold-use observation, and the recipient's actual use review. commission_kiln_day_five_08.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_day_five_08.text: The completed fifth-day work left the sale pieces packed, the final review booked and the selected service prepared within its actual status. commission_kiln_day_five_09.text: Yue asked Peng what she might be responsible for after this term. commission_kiln_day_five_10.text: Peng paid seven copper for the completed fifth shift. Yue had received thirty-five commission wages. Seven remained for the final unworked shift. commission_kiln_day_five_11.speaker: narrator
commission_kiln_day_five_11.text: The next morning the cart arrived at the shared kitchen under its paid dispatch terms. commission_kiln_day_five_12.speaker: tian_min
commission_kiln_day_five_12.text: Tian read the detailed use-comparison record before the common final checks. commission_kiln_method_reader.text: The detailed method record changed the receiving explanation. Its earlier decision selected a completed handling block, cloth comparison or source-led use map. commission_kiln_method_late_handling.text: Yue showed Tian the completed partnered-handling block, including the late first turn call and shortened repetition count. commission_kiln_method_late_handling_03.text: Tian asked whether a cook unable to manage the partnered route would lose access to the purchased bowls. commission_kiln_method_late_handling_04.text: The detailed handling record remained beside the common current receiving observation, with the two routes clearly distinguished. commission_kiln_method_late_handling_05.speaker: lin_yue
commission_kiln_method_late_handling_05.text: She completed the handling explanation within her receiving commission and gave Tian the permitted record. commission_kiln_method_late_cloth.text: Yue showed Tian the smooth reference square, offered repaired section and numbered cold-rim observations. commission_kiln_method_late_cloth_02.text: Tian understood the distinction because the cloth was hers. commission_kiln_method_late_cloth_05.text: Yue finished the cloth explanation within the receiving commission and returned the offered cloth under its custody note. commission_kiln_method_late_sources.text: The permitted source-led packet reached Tian with three offered uses kept distinct. commission_kiln_method_late_sources_03.text: The cupboard's actual opening supported selecting the lower current piece for the declared upright entry. commission_kiln_method_late_sources_04.text: She showed Tian the corrected commercial summary beside the distinct offered notes. commission_kiln_recovery_reader.text: The receiving review next examined the correction actually performed after the failed recommendation.
